correctness.rationale: Iterating the skew map gives y_j=y+jx+j(j−1)alpha/2, and Haar invariance. Every distinct-time pair is uniform on T² because the integer two-time character matrix has nonzero determinant, while translating y by 1/2 flips all signs; Walsh inversion implies every triple is uniform. For irrational alpha, polynomial Weyl equidistribution yields unique ergodicity; O(n) spanning numbers at fixed accuracy give topological entropy 0, hence factor entropy0. Fourier coefficients of the half-circle sign are 2/(i pi k) for odd k. The two torus-character constraints reduce the 4-point AP correlation to an absolutely convergent sum with coefficient 1/27 at zero and 6 sin(2pi r/3)/(pi³r³) for nonzero r, determining the stated continuous piecewise quadratic Theta. The transformation x↦hx+binom(h,2)alpha pushes Haar to Haar, giving Theta(h²alpha). Exceptional roots modulo half period are t=1/(4sqrt3) and 1/2-1/(4sqrt3); Theta(4alpha)=−9+16/sqrt3>0, so not 4-wise independent globally. Independently evaluated two-torus midpoint grids (1800² points per test) at five parameters; absolute discrepancies below 0.004. Finite grids do not establish Fourier identity.
